## Security and Verification Checklist

- [ ] Zero runtime secrets or private tokens (e.g. Supabase service role key) committed.
- [ ] Row-Level Security (RLS) integrity preserved in all database schema updates.
- [ ] DOM manipulations safely use `textContent` or sanitized fragments (no unsanitized `innerHTML`).
- [ ] Tested and verified across modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
- [ ] Code strictly follows vanilla JavaScript conventions without adding heavy external dependencies.
